Subtract 244 days from 1401-12-17.  
1401 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1401-12-17 back 17 days → 1401-11-30.  
Remaining 244 − 17 = 227 days earlier.  
Back into October: 31 days in Oct → 1401-10-31 (227 − 30 = 197 left).  
Continue subtracting month days: Sep 30, Aug 31, Jul 31, Jun 30, May 31, Apr 30, Mar 31, Feb 28.  
Sum: 30+31+31+30+31+30+31+28 = 242 days back from 1401-10-31 → 242 − 197 = 45 days too many, so stop earlier.  
Actually step month-by-month from 1401-10-31:  
197 days before:  
Sep 30 → 197−30=167 left, date 1401-09-30.  
Aug 31 → 167−31=136, date 1401-08-31.  
Jul 31 → 136−31=105, date 1401-07-31.  
Jun 30 → 105−30=75, date 1401-06-30.  
May 31 → 75−31=44, date 1401-05-31.  
Apr 30 → 44−30=14, date 1401-04-30.  
Then back 14 more days into April: 1401-04-16.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1401-04-16
